notes: Multi Studio version 2.1.40: **Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview Model**: Added `Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview` to the AI Scriber model selector, enabling advanced multimodal reasoning, verbatim speech transcription, and long audio clip processing., **Native Script Punctuation Preservation**: Enforced native script punctuation guidelines (including Khmer Khan `។`, Cam-noke-tho `៖`, and Thai clause/punctuation marks) in the AI Scriber system prompt to prevent LLMs from omitting local language punctuation marks., **Phonetic Verbatim Accuracy for Short Clips**: Hardened transcription instructions and enabled greedy decoding (`topP: 0.1`) to prevent LLMs from substituting, paraphrasing, or auto-correcting spoken colloquial Khmer and Thai words on short audio clips.
